Extension utilities: bring-your-own SQL + project workspace helpers.

Source: R/extend.R
register_concept_sql.Rd

These functions cover two common scenarios:

  1. You found a SQL query somewhere and want to run it as a concept.

  2. You want a project-specific schema or database to keep derived work separate from the raw source schemas. Adapt and register an external SQL query as a concept

Usage

register_concept_sql(
  sql,
  src_name,
  concept_name,
  schema = "concepts",
  save_to = NULL,
  module = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  dry_run = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE,
  origin_name = NULL,
  origin_url = NULL,
  origin_ref = NULL,
  con = NULL
)

Arguments

sql

Source SQL. Either a file path or an inline SQL string.

src_name

Source name (e.g. "mimic_iv_demo"). Determines which schema prefixes to strip.

concept_name

Name for the output table.

schema

Target schema for the concept table. Accepts a key from src_schema_names() ("concepts", "derived", "flat", "ts", "dur") or any literal schema name. Default "concepts" -> _coh_concepts.

save_to

Where to write the adapted SQL. Default NULL writes to sql/{src_name}/concepts_sqls/user/{concept_name}.sql (or .../external/{module}/{concept_name}.sql when module is given) so a later run_concepts() call picks it up automatically, the same as if you had dropped the file there by hand. Pass FALSE to skip saving, or an explicit path to save elsewhere.

module

Optional external-layer module name. When given, the default save_to targets external/{module}/ (its own schema on the next run_concepts() call) instead of user/. Ignored if save_to is given explicitly.

base_dir

Project root directory, used only to resolve the default save_to path. Defaults to the current working directory.

dry_run

If TRUE (default), only build/save the adapted SQL - do not execute it. Set FALSE (or pass con) to execute immediately.

overwrite

Prepend DROP TABLE IF EXISTS before CREATE. Default FALSE.

origin_name

Optional human-readable source name for provenance.

origin_url

Optional URL (repo, paper, DOI) for provenance.

origin_ref

Optional citation string for provenance.

con

Optional explicit DBI connection. Implies dry_run = FALSE.

Value

The adapted SQL string invisibly. Inspect it before executing.

Details

Takes a SQL file (or inline SQL string) found online, in a paper supplement, or written by hand and does three things:

  1. Strips known schema prefixes (mimiciv_hosp., mimiciv_icu., eicu_crd., etc.) so bare table names resolve against search_path.

  2. Wraps the query in CREATE TABLE {target_schema}.{concept_name} AS.

  3. Optionally saves the adapted SQL and/or executes it immediately, registering provenance in concept_registry.

After running, the concept is queryable with fetch_concept().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ehr_connect("rendehrdov", creds)

# Preview adapted SQL from a file (does NOT execute, but does save to
# sql/mimic_iv_demo/concepts_sqls/user/sofa_renal_custom.sql by default)
adapted <- register_concept_sql(
  "downloads/sofa_renal.sql",
  src_name     = "mimic_iv_demo",
  concept_name = "sofa_renal_custom"
)
cat(adapted)

# Execute, with provenance, keeping the default save location
register_concept_sql(
  "downloads/sofa_renal.sql",
  src_name     = "mimic_iv_demo",
  concept_name = "sofa_renal_custom",
  schema       = "derived",
  dry_run      = FALSE,
  overwrite    = TRUE,
  origin_name  = "Smith et al. 2023",
  origin_url   = "https://doi.org/10.xxxx",
  origin_ref   = "Smith J. et al., J Neurotrauma 2023"
)

# Inline SQL string, executed immediately, not saved to disk
register_concept_sql(
  "SELECT subject_id, hadm_id, stay_id,
          charttime AS index_time,
          valuenum  AS value
   FROM   mimiciv_icu.chartevents
   WHERE  itemid = 220045",
  src_name     = "mimic_iv_demo",
  concept_name = "heart_rate_raw",
  save_to      = FALSE,
  dry_run      = FALSE
)
} # }
